selection_reasons.01_exploit_neighbor_message_passing.md: Highest implementation-fit exploit that directly adds neighbor context while preserving the scalar energy and autograd-force contract.
selection_reasons.02_exploit_angular_triplet_head.md: Best direct test of the evidence-backed directional/body-order gap in the current pair-only model.
selection_reasons.03_exploit_residual_pair_graph.md: Lower-complexity exploit branch that isolates the value of richer local interaction parameterization without full angular or equivariant machinery.
selection_reasons.04_jump_minimal_equivariant_local.md: Primary next-phase jump, selected because verified paper and repo evidence most strongly support a minimal equivariant local model as the clearest representation upgrade.
selection_reasons.05_jump_cace_body_order_bridge.md: Selected as a bridge jump to cover higher-body structure without committing only to an irreps-heavy route.
selection_reasons.06_jump_equivariant_triplet_hybrid.md: Selected as one aggressive jump branch to test whether combining equivariance with explicit directional summaries unlocks a stronger signal than either alone.
selection_reasons.07_backward_simplify_atomwise_local_base: Selected as the required simplification/calibration branch to measure whether some current pair complexity is unnecessary noise.
selection_reasons.08_control_replicate_base_unit.md: Mandatory control replicate for run-to-run variance estimation.

jump_proposal_reasons.04_jump_minimal_equivariant_local.md: Most evidence-backed next-phase jump from fresh verified local PDFs and verified NequIP/MACE repo inspection.
jump_proposal_reasons.05_jump_cace_body_order_bridge.md: Provides a distinct body-order bridge hypothesis with better bounded fit than immediately betting only on full equivariance.
jump_proposal_reasons.06_jump_equivariant_triplet_hybrid.md: High-upside hybrid probe to test whether the current frontier needs both directional structure and symmetry-aware interactions together.

why_wildcards_unselected.09_wildcard_les_side_branch.md: Evidence-backed but less aligned to the dominant local geometry gap for this benchmark pair.
why_wildcards_unselected.10_wildcard_taip_side_branch.md: Benchmark-relevant in principle but weakest immediate implementation fit for a bounded next round.

materialization_constraints: Do not change benchmark formulas, split semantics, metric field names, or runnable unit entrypoint contract.
Materialize each selected proposal as its own runnable unit under one generation container.
Do not launch runs in the same step as selection.
